text: 澳洲联储副主席豪泽表示，尽管该行此前大幅加息，试图遏制持续顽固的高通胀，但公众对央行的信任度依然保持稳固，这令他感到意外。豪泽表示：“过去18个月，我们整体信任度指标大体保持稳定，甚至略有上升。在利率上升、通胀远高于目标区间的这段时期，这一结果令人欣慰，但坦率地说，也相当出乎意料。”澳洲联储本周实施了2026年以来的第五次加息，将现金利率上调至4.85%，创18年来新高。此举可能进一步加重房贷持有者的负担。与此同时，他们还面临燃油价格上涨、生活成本压力加剧、失业率上升以及房地产市场走软等多重压力，这些因素正令消费者信心持续陷入悲观区间。豪泽提醒道：“这些
text_en: RBA Deputy Governor Hauser said he was surprised that public trust in the central bank remained solid despite its aggressive rate hikes aimed at curbing persistently sticky high inflation. Hauser said: "Over the past 18 months, our overall trust indicator has remained broadly stable, even rising slightly. This is a gratifying outcome during a period of rising interest rates and inflation far above the target range, but frankly, it is also quite unexpected." The RBA this week delivered its fifth rate hike of 2026, raising the cash rate to 4.85%, an 18-year high. The move may further weigh on mortgage holders. Meanwhile, they also face multiple pressures including higher fuel prices, intensifying cost-of-living pressures, rising unemployment and a softening housing market, factors that are keeping consumer confidence in pessimistic territory.
